io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun4.api.items

Class SlimefunItem

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun4.api.items.SlimefunItem

  • public class SlimefunItem
extends java.lang.Object
    Backwards-compatibility shim for the pre-relocation Slimefun package.

    This fork relocated Slimefun's API from io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun4.* to io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.*. Third-party plugins - and libraries they shade, such as ProjectUnified UniItem (used by ExtraStorage and others) - were compiled against the old package and reference io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun4.api.items.SlimefunItem, so they fail with NoClassDefFoundError on this fork. This thin bridge re-exposes the minimal SlimefunItem surface those integrations actually use, delegating every call to the real SlimefunItem.

    Intentionally minimal: only the members third-party item-identification code depends on are provided (getByItem(ItemStack), getById(String), getId(), getItem(), isItem(ItemStack)). Extend it only when a real plugin needs more - do NOT mirror the whole API.
